scope: Four named research-required organizations assessed for exact identity, Canada-first inclusion, concrete underwater-service or accelerator role, delivery proof, conflicts and terminal disposition.

prospects.name: MAKO Diving & Marine Services
prospects.fitSummary: MAKO Diving & Marine Services should be selected so reviewers can assess its ROV- and sonar-assisted underwater inspection and search, Canadian operating evidence and record-specific warnings against current official and independent public sources.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the exact incorporated name, 2021 distinct-company origin, president and official veteran-ownership statement.
Recovered a concrete ROV service boundary and use conditions, but no public model, depth, payload or sensor specification.
Recovered current COR status and 2026-12-06 expiry for the exact legal entity.
Recovered independent evidence of a September 2023 MAKO ROV survey and October 2023 diving work.
Recovered repeat municipal procurement participation, explicitly not an award.

Final exact-name federal and provincial public-registry recovery produced no public shareholder or beneficial-ownership record; legal identity remained independently triangulated by current COR and association directories.
Final DND, DFO, RCMP and federal-award lane produced no recent award; it recovered only a 2023 vendor-partnering profile for the exact legal entity.

prospects.fitSummary: Dominion Divers should be selected so reviewers can assess its ROV and sonar infrastructure inspection, Canadian operating evidence and record-specific warnings against current official and independent public sources.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the exact current legal entity, file number, effective amalgamation date and all predecessor corporations.
Recovered the current Dominion Divers Marine Contractors business-name registration and exact operating address.
Independently corroborated the title change from the 2003 entity to Dominion Divers (2025) Ltd. and exact address.
Recovered concrete inspection-class ROV, diver-inspection, NDT and infrastructure use cases but no model-level operating envelope.
Recovered a current CAD 866,736.06 federal award at the exact Navin address with delivery through 2027.
Final exact DND and Royal Canadian Navy award search produced no current defence contract for Dominion Divers (2025) Ltd.
Final model/configuration lane confirmed inspection-class ROV and sonar outputs but produced no ROV make, depth, payload or configuration.

prospects.name: Advanced Subsea Services
prospects.fitSummary: Advanced Subsea Services should be selected so reviewers can assess its Inspection ROV and subsea survey services, Canadian operating evidence and record-specific warnings against current official and independent public sources.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the exact official Sidney mailing address and current public operations contact routes.

prospects.name: Propellant Labs
prospects.fitSummary: Propellant Labs was assessed to determine whether a durable Canadian operating nexus exists; the resolved California LLC and exhaustive zero-yield Canada lanes support terminal exclusion.
prospects.rejectionReason: Propellant Labs is a real active California LLC operating a global remote accelerator, but exhaustive Canada-first recovery found no Canadian legal entity, office, staff member, Canada-specific program, named Canadian cohort participant, Canadian partner, procurement, grant or other durable operating nexus. Global availability, 25-plus-country reach and remote enrollment do not establish Canadian presence. The record should be excluded from the Canada-first organization corpus and re-opened only if a durable source establishes a Canadian entity, location, employee, funded program, partner or named participant.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the active global accelerator offer and 2026 lifecycle but no Canadian program, location or participant.
Recovered the active California LLC, Temecula address, filing number and US managers.
Recovered independent accelerator/support corroboration but no Canadian partner or operating nexus.
Searched cohort, founder and city variants for Canada, Toronto, Vancouver and Montreal; no durable named Canadian participant was recovered.
Final Canada.ca, ISED and BDC exact-name grant and program lane produced zero exact organization evidence.
Final CanadaBuys exact-name lane produced zero procurement, award or supplier evidence for Propellant Labs LLC.
Final Canadian entity, office, staff, partner and participant searches returned only global-access claims and unrelated rocket-propellant noise.
